title: Controlled source packet: domain and evidence brief
excerpt: The proposed study concerns conductivity alerts from river sensors. Conductivity is not a direct measurement of pathogen concentration. A reference instrument will be used to identify sensor drift. The alert threshold is 900 microsiemens per centimetre, and values equal to the threshold are not exceedances.

title: Controlled source packet: experimental design brief
excerpt: Eight sensors will be compared over 21 days. Raw readings and drift-corrected readings will use the same fixed threshold. Corrections will be estimated from the reference instrument, not from whether an alert appears plausible. The study will not make drinking-water safety recommendations.
